description: Compressor A1 Motor Temperature Too High
reason: Compressor motor sensor PTC resistance is greater than 4.5k ohms
control_action: Circuit shut down or not allowed to start
probable_causes: Wiring error to motor temperature sensor
diagnostic_steps: Verify motor sensor PTC wiring and connections at compressor terminal box
Measure PTC resistance — should be 50 ohms to 4.5k ohms at operating temperature
Check refrigerant charge and condenser airflow
Inspect for restricted refrigerant flow or high discharge pressure

reason: High pressure switch open on circuit A1
control_action: Circuit shut down or not allowed to start
diagnostic_steps: Verify condenser fans operating and coils clean
Check discharge pressure transducer reading against gauge
Inspect for non-condensables or overcharge
Confirm high pressure switch wiring

description: Compressor A1 Motor Sensor PTC Out of Range
reason: Compressor motor sensor PTC resistance is less than 50 ohms or greater than 17k ohms
control_action: Circuit shut down or not allowed to start
probable_causes: Open or shorted PTC sensor wiring
diagnostic_steps: Disconnect PTC sensor and measure resistance at sensor leads
Inspect wiring harness for damage at compressor and MBB
Replace sensor if resistance is out of range with verified wiring

reason: Crankcase heater current not detected when required or detected when not required
control_action: Compressor shut down or not allowed to start
diagnostic_steps: Verify crankcase heater contactor operation
Measure heater current draw during energized period
Inspect SPM board connections

description: Loss of Communication with Compressor Board A1
reason: No communication with scroll protection module on circuit A1
diagnostic_steps: Check LEN bus wiring between MBB and SPM board
Verify 24 VAC power to SPM board
Inspect NetCtrl/LEN connections at TB3
Replace SPM board if communication not restored

reason: Condenser pressure exceeded protective limit during operation
diagnostic_steps: Verify cooling tower operation and condenser water delta-T
Check condenser pressure transducer calibration
Inspect water-side strainers and isolation valves
Review recent refrigerant service history

reason: Motor current exceeded maximum allowable during operation
diagnostic_steps: Measure line voltage and current on all three phases
Check for voltage imbalance greater than 2%
Review condenser pressure and evaporator temperature at trip
Perform megohm test on motor windings

reason: Line current unbalance exceeded allowable threshold
control_action: Alert — unit may continue with caution
diagnostic_steps: Measure line current on all three phases at full load
Check line voltage unbalance at disconnect
Tighten all power connections at starter and compressor

reason: Suction pressure below minimum operating threshold
diagnostic_steps: Verify chilled water flow and delta-T across evaporator
Check suction pressure transducer reading
Inspect expansion valve superheat setting
Look for signs of low charge or leak

reason: Chilled water flow switch open while unit commanded to run
probable_causes: Chilled water pump off or failed
diagnostic_steps: Verify chilled water pump operation
Check isolation valve positions
Clean strainer and verify flow rate
Test flow switch operation

control_action: Compressor shut down or not allowed to start
probable_causes: Low voltage from main power supply
diagnostic_steps: Measure 24 VAC at SPM board power input
Check control power transformer and fuses
Verify main power supply stability
Allow motor to cool and verify overload reset
Review motor amp history prior to trip
Test motor insulation resistance
Inspect starter overload settings against nameplate

reason: Ground fault current detected between output phases and ground
diagnostic_steps: Perform megohm test on motor windings phase to ground
Inspect power cables and junction box for moisture or damage
Do not restart until ground fault source is identified

reason: Saturated condensing temperature exceeded alarm threshold
diagnostic_steps: Verify all condenser fans operating at full speed
Clean condenser coils
Check ambient temperature against design conditions
Verify refrigerant charge

reason: Chilled water loop temperature below freeze protection setpoint
control_action: Cooler heater energized; unit may lock out
probable_causes: Chilled water flow loss with unit running
diagnostic_steps: Verify cooler heater operation
Check chilled water flow and pump status
Confirm freeze protection setpoint configuration

reason: One or more line phases lost during operation
diagnostic_steps: Measure voltage on all three phases at unit disconnect
Check fuses and contactor poles
Verify utility power stability before restart

description: Compressor A2 Motor Temperature Too High
reason: Compressor motor sensor PTC resistance is greater than 4.5k ohms on circuit A2
control_action: Circuit shut down or not allowed to start
diagnostic_steps: Verify motor sensor PTC wiring on circuit A2
Measure PTC resistance at compressor terminal box
Check refrigerant charge and operating pressures

reason: Earth (ground) fault current exists between output phases and ground
probable_causes: Moisture in drive or motor junction box
diagnostic_steps: Inspect motor and cable insulation
Check for moisture at drive output terminals
Megohm test motor before restart
